hooks.command: [ -n "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_N8N_API_URL" ] && [ -n "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_N8N_API_KEY" ] || echo '{"systemMessage": "mcp-n8n has no settings yet, so its MCP server cannot start. Since 2.0.0 it no longer reads N8N_API_KEY from your shell. Run /plugin configure mcp-n8n@wookstar-claude-plugins (or claude plugin configure mcp-n8n@wookstar-claude-plugins in a terminal), then restart Claude Code."}'
